scope: Partition complete block replacement into LayerNorm-only and Attention+MLP-only controls on unprotected experts; no new defense.
motivation: The earlier block replacement included LayerNorm. Determine whether affine normalization or combined nonlinear modules account for the loss before selecting a joint mechanism.
confirmation: Reuse the same 4000 MNIST training confirmation images as the earlier support runs, disjoint from parent calibration, attack and development subsets. Previously inspected; not a fresh holdout.
evaluation: Existing MNIST-2000/SVHN-1000 development and MNIST-4000 confirmation training subsets; paired dependency diagnosis only.
fitting: None; no labels, activation targets, optimizer or gradient used in replacement.
novelty: Pretrained MLP bypass is already discussed by the AGA paper; these measurements only audit this project's protection support.
